arguments.question: 直前に観測された reg.exe と Discord.exe のつながりについて、同じ主体からの親子関係を最小限で裏づけたいです。reg.exe の直前にいる親プロセスと、その reg.exe の直後に出る子プロセスが観測されていれば各1件だけ示してください。time、PID、PPID、process_name/pname、command_line、parent_process_name、parent_process_path、parent_command_line、childproc_name、event_record_id、source_stream を含め、同一候補の順序がわかる形でお願いします。

arguments.query:
WITH reg AS (
  SELECT time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line,
         childproc_name, event_record_id, source_stream,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY time, event_record_id) AS rn
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE (process_name LIKE '%reg.exe%' OR pname LIKE '%reg.exe%')
), reg_with_prev AS (
  SELECT r.*, (
    SELECT process_name
    FROM audit_logs p
    WHERE p.pid = r.ppid
      AND p.time <= r.time
    ORDER BY p.time DESC, p.event_record_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS prev_process_name,
  (
    SELECT pname
    FROM audit_logs p
    WHERE p.pid = r.ppid
      AND p.time <= r.time
    ORDER BY p.time DESC, p.event_record_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS prev_pname,
  (
    SELECT command_line
    FROM audit_logs p
    WHERE p.pid = r.ppid
      AND p.time <= r.time
    ORDER BY p.time DESC, p.event_record_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS prev_command_line,
  (
    SELECT parent_process_name
    FROM audit_logs c
    WHERE c.ppid = r.pid
      AND c.time >= r.time
    ORDER BY c.time ASC, c.event_record_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS next_child_name
  FROM reg r
)
SELECT time, pid, ppid, process_name, pname, command_line,
       prev_process_name AS parent_process_name,
       NULL AS parent_process_path,
       prev_command_line AS parent_command_line,
       next_child_name AS childproc_name,
       event_record_id, source_stream
FROM reg_with_prev
WHERE prev_process_name IS NOT NULL OR next_child_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, event_record_id
LIMIT 1;

WITH reg AS (
  SELECT time, pid, ppid, pname, process_name, command_line, parent_process_name, parent_process_path, parent_command_line,
         childproc_name, event_record_id, source_stream
  FROM audit_logs
  WHERE (process_name LIKE '%reg.exe%' OR pname LIKE '%reg.exe%')
    AND time IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY time, event_record_id
  LIMIT 50
)
SELECT r.time, r.pid, r.ppid, r.process_name, r.pname, r.command_line,
       r.parent_process_name,
       r.parent_process_path,
       r.parent_command_line,
       (
         SELECT c.childproc_name
         FROM audit_logs c
         WHERE c.ppid = r.pid
           AND c.time >= r.time
           AND c.childproc_name IS NOT NULL
         ORDER BY c.time ASC, c.event_record_id ASC
         LIMIT 1
       ) AS childproc_name,
       r.event_record_id, r.source_stream
FROM reg r
WHERE r.ppid IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    r.parent_process_name IS NOT NULL
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM audit_logs p
      WHERE p.pid = r.ppid AND p.time <= r.time
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM audit_logs c
      WHERE c.ppid = r.pid AND c.time >= r.time AND c.childproc_name IS NOT NULL
    )
  )
ORDER BY r.time, r.event_record_id
LIMIT 1;
